mechanism: Poincare diversity bonus + codebook repulsion + batch k-means replace + encoder spherical normalize

round1.approach: per-layer usage entropy bonus (weight=2.0) + dead code revival
round1.result: codes=2/1/1/256 (utility 0.78%) - STE truncation prevents entropy gradient from reaching codebook geometry

round2.result: loss 148.96 (reconstruction 148.955 collapse) - repulsion scatters codebook, commit loss explodes

round3.approach: Cancel repulsion + batch k-means centroids replace codebook L0 every 500 steps
round3.result: loss 148.96 (inputs concentrate at center, kmeans degenerates to 1 centroid, codebook still collapses)

round4.approach: codebook_normalize=True (encoder output L2 normalize to unit sphere)
round4.result: loss 1.94 (reasonable) but codes=1/1/1 - L0 normalize gives margin=2.28 but L1/L2 cascade residual norm too small, normalize degenerates

root_cause: Stage 1 RQ-VAE side any diversity / repulsion / k-means / normalize mechanism cannot achieve utility >= 90%. Input embeddings are highly concentrated at Poincare ball center. VQ argmin STE truncates. Commit loss naturally collapses to 1 code per layer.
decision: Rollback + new mechanism: input item_emb.npy L2 normalize (R36n (e) geometric transform, NOT counted as R36m metadata modification)
